beauty.title: Palais Garnier — staircase and gilded interiors
beauty.description: Woman on grand staircase, ornate balustrades, gold-painted grand foyer, ceiling paintings, chandeliers and mosaic ceiling. Burned-in line: People seriously go to Paris and skip places like this? Not Paris Fashion Week coverage.

beauty.title: One day in Cannes — Carlton and Croisette
beauty.description: Carlton Hotel exterior and turret, fine-dining dishes, palm-lined promenade, Cartier and Versace storefronts, a luxury car and additional Cannes hotel frontage. Not Carlton-only footage.

beauty.title: Paris sunset — AquaKyoto rooftop dining
beauty.description: Rooftop restaurant with Eiffel Tower at sunset, cocktails, sushi and sashimi, table service, dining room and dessert. Burned-in Paris / With AquaKyoto text.

beauty.title: BnF — oval reading-room interior
beauty.description: Tall book-lined oval library reading room with glazed ceiling, circular windows, desks and readers. Burned-in Oldest National Library in France / Since 1368 text is transcribed, not independently verified historical dating. Not Palais Garnier.

beauty.title: Galeries Lafayette — dome and glass walkway
beauty.description: Camera moves along glass-railed walkway across department-store atrium and tilts up to the stained-glass dome. Burned-in Just a Shopping mall in Paris text. Not Salon du Chocolat footage.
